motivation: Nepal v5 has near-zero recorded and latent event probabilities with approximately chance event discrimination, while its model-implied control signal retains some temporal/joint ordering. The next synthetic question is whether local organizational state is transmitted monotonically into action opportunity and execution under controlled exposure.

nuisance_normalization: use a locality with an existing fixed government security target and no local insurgent field formation
hold actor beliefs fixed within seed across capacity doses
set insurgent local_knowledge and material capital to one in every dose
place one insurgent material source at the focal locality with identical ample stock in every dose

secondary_falsifier: At fixed beliefs and positive local capacity, removing the true fixed-security target must leave planning weights unchanged but prevent a forced nonfielded human-target action from realizing.
acceptance_gate: zero capacity implies zero attempt and zero expected latent-event propensity
attempt probability is strictly increasing over every positive capacity dose
execution probability is strictly increasing over every positive capacity dose
expected nonfielded latent-event propensity is strictly increasing over every positive capacity dose
adding focal capacity does not change action-attempt probability in an untreated control locality
the target-access falsifier separates belief-based planning from truth-constrained execution
all eight seeds pass with stable model and tracked-diff hashes
interpretation: A pass establishes only that the implemented v5 state-to-action equations can transmit known local capacity monotonically under controlled synthetic exposure. It does not show that Nepal's historical latent state, beliefs, support, target access, or rate scale are correct.
